analyst_view.overall: Early view: with a month to go, Trabzonspor (12th, six points) host Jablonec (23rd, two points) on matchday 5. Trabzonspor are third in the Turkish Süper Lig with 24 goals in ten league games; Jablonec have been hard to beat, losing only 3-2 at Freiburg and drawing with Brighton and at Riga. Trabzonspor are clear favourites at home.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.7 goals, 1.9 for Trabzonspor. Trabzonspor score freely in Turkey, but Jablonec held Brighton 0-0 and drew 1-1 at Riga; those cancel out, so I stay with the number.

corners.text: The numbers say 8.8 corners. Jablonec defend deep and are a threat from corners themselves, as against Brighton, but nothing moves the total.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.6 cards, more for Jablonec. That fits an away side defending for long spells in a loud stadium; I stay with the number.

shots.text: The numbers say 30.0 shots, 19.0 for Trabzonspor. A deep Jablonec block should allow plenty of home attempts, which the number already reflects.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 9.7 shots on target. Jablonec's keeper Jan Hanus made several good saves against Brighton; I stay with the number.
